concerns.text: T015b requires a unit test that 'simulates a missing creativity score (mocking the old check)' to verify the code proceeds to check for Fluid Intelligence. However, T015 explicitly mandates the 'remove/replace' of all logic checking for 'Musical Creativity'. A test cannot mock or verify the behavior of a logic path that has been deleted. This creates a semantic dependency violation where the consumer (test) requires a producer (old logic) that the plan explicitly forbids.

T032b requires a unit test that 'attempts to call an FDR function... and verifies it is either removed or raises a NotImplementedError'. If the function is truly removed (as required by the pivot to Bonferroni), the test will fail with an ImportError/NameError, not a controlled NotImplementedError. The task description implies the function must exist to be called, contradicting the requirement to remove it. This is a semantic ordering/logic violation.

T011 (Implement Resource Monitoring Integration) depends on T009 (Implement ResourceMonitor Class). However, T011 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) in Phase 2. If T009 is not yet complete, T011 cannot be implemented or tested. Marking a task that consumes an artifact from another task as parallel-safe violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule and the definition of [P].

T019a is marked [X] (complete) and verifies `preprocessing_stats.json` generated by T017b. However, T017b is marked [ ] (pending) and is the producer of that artifact. A verification task cannot be marked complete before the artifact it verifies is generated. This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' ordering principle.
